patch_list: 2D / 3D compass

Adds a 2D / 3D compass switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, tapping the compass in navigate mode switches the map between the tilted 3D view and a flat, north-up 2D map the way Google Maps' does, from any state (following you, pa…
Better filters

Adds a Better filters switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filter's sliders move in finer steps over the same ranges: Rating in 0.1 stars (instead of Any, 3.5, 4 and 4.5), Length in 0.1 mi, Elevation gain in 10 ft, High…
Better tracking

Adds a Better tracking switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, recordings work the way Gaia GPS records: the phone's GPS directly with every fix delivered live (no Play services batching), fixes worse than 65 m or physically impossi…
Black icon
Uses a white AllTrails logo on black for the launcher icon and the splash screen, instead of green on dark green, so this build is easy to tell apart from the stock app.
Change package name
Installs alongside stock AllTrails under its own package name.
Experimental screen
Adds an Experimental row to your profile's menu, under Edit profile and Share profile, that opens an Experimental screen.
Remember filters

Adds a Remember filter states switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filters you set (length, elevation, rating, difficulty, activities, features and the rest, but not Distance away) stay set when you go back to the home…
Theme
Adds a Theme choice to the Experimental screen: Follow phone, Light, Dark or AMOLED black (dark with pure black backgrounds). AllTrails itself only follows the phone.
